macros.name: lquote
macros.doc: The commands ``\lquote'' and ``\rquote'' just typeset the quote marks in the current style without changing it.

macros.name: quoted
macros.doc: ``\quoted'' formats its argument in correct quotes.

macros.name: rquote
macros.doc: The commands ``\lquote'' and ``\rquote'' just typeset the quote marks in the current style without changing it.
